app.title: Picco Garage
app.tagline: Build it. Paint it. Drive it like you own the road.
landing.guest_note: Guests can drive, but can't save, buy or join leaderboards.
landing.feature1.title: Your garage
landing.feature1.body: Paint tuk-tuks and Leyland-style buses. Name plates, stickers, fairy lights, horns.
landing.feature2.title: Sri Lankan roads
landing.feature2.body: Colombo streets, misty hills, the coast road, Flood Town and Market Junction.
landing.feature3.title: Race & roam
landing.feature3.body: Bus route races, tuk-tuk dashes, time trials, weekly series, or just cruise.
landing.privacy.title: Your privacy
landing.privacy.body: Signing in with Google shares only your name, email and profile picture with us. We never see your Google password. We save your garage designs, coins, purchases and race results so you can play on any device. You can delete your game data any time in Settings.
